info.name: Family Hub API
info.description:
Family Hub API, generated from apps/api/openapi.json. Do not edit by hand:
run `pnpm -F api openapi:generate` after any API change.

**Get a parent token (folder 01):** set `supabaseAnonKey` and `signInEmail`, send
"Send sign-in email" (or "Send sign-up email" for a new parent). Copy the link in the
email (do not click it: a click uses it up), paste it into `emailLink`, then send
"Verify email link". It saves `userToken`.
A new parent then creates their family with POST /api/public/tenant (folder 04).

Other variables:
- `tenantSlug`: the family web address, e.g. `khan-family`.
- `kidToken`: saved by POST /api/auth/kid-pin (needs `kidMemberId` and `kidPin`).
- `*Id` variables: the id of the record a request acts on.

request.description:
Liveness probe: is the process up and serving requests

**Sign-in:** none
**Success:** 200

Hello sanity check: a static greeting plus the current time

**Sign-in:** none
**Success:** 200

**Success:** 200

Creates the parent account if needed and emails a confirmation link to `signInEmail`.

**Sign-in:** none (Supabase public key)
**Success:** 200

Copy the whole link from the email (do not click it) into `emailLink` first. Saves `userToken` for every parent request.

**Sign-in:** none (Supabase public key)
**Success:** 200

Exchange a kid PIN for a kid session token

**Sign-in:** none
**Success:** 200

Public ICS calendar feed for one family, for Google/Apple/Outlook (signed token = credential, no sign-in)

Parses and verifies the signed token before touching any event row; every failure (bad signature, rotated-out key, unknown tenant) returns the same bare 404, so the endpoint never reveals which families exist. Only includes events from the last 90 days onward; future events are unbounded.

**Sign-in:** none
**Success:** 200

Submit anonymous homepage feedback

Unauthenticated visitors submit product feedback from the public homepage. All fields optional but at least one survey field (not just name/email) must be present.

**Sign-in:** none
**Success:** 200

List a family's kids who can log in with a PIN

**Sign-in:** none
**Success:** 200

Check if a family URL slug is free

**Sign-in:** none
**Success:** 200

Finish the onboarding wizard; admin only

Atomically sets tenant timezone/currency, renames the caller to yourName (if given), inserts one members row per wizard-added member, marks onboarding_completed, seeds starter habits/rewards, then best-effort emails an invite to each adult member that carried an email. Idempotent: a repeat call after completion returns the current tenant unchanged with membersAdded: 0, invitesSent: 0.

**Sign-in:** parent or adult token (`userToken`)
**Success:** 200

State of the dashboard setup guide for the calling admin

**Sign-in:** parent or adult token (`userToken`)
**Success:** 200

Hide the dashboard setup guide for the calling admin, on every device

**Sign-in:** parent or adult token (`userToken`)
**Success:** 200

Create a family (sign-up onboarding)

**Sign-in:** parent or adult token (`userToken`)
**Success:** 200

The signed-in user + their families

**Sign-in:** parent or adult token (`userToken`)
**Success:** 200

List family members

**Sign-in:** parent or adult token (`userToken`)
**Success:** 200

Add a family member seat (child, teen, or adult); admin only

No login is created: this is a direct roster insert, not an invite.

**Sign-in:** parent or adult token (`userToken`)
**Success:** 201

Rename a member and/or toggle their admin↔adult role; admin only

role may only move between admin and adult (kid roles are fixed at creation). The target must already be adult/admin to be touched; an admin can't demote themselves, and the last remaining admin can never be demoted or removed. 400 with a reason when a guard blocks the change; 404 if the member is not in this tenant.

**Sign-in:** parent or adult token (`userToken`)
**Success:** 200

Remove a member from the family; admin only

Their content (tasks, habits, etc.) cascades with them. The last remaining admin can never be removed. 404 if the member is not in this tenant.

**Sign-in:** parent or adult token (`userToken`)
**Success:** 200

Start changing a grown-up member's sign-in email; admin-only

Emails a one-time confirm link to the NEW address, plus a best-effort heads-up notice to the OLD address (never blocks this response). The old address keeps working until the link is clicked. 400 NO_LOGIN_EMAIL if the target has no linked login; 409 if the new email already belongs to a Family Hub account, or if a concurrent request for the same member won the race.

**Sign-in:** parent or adult token (`userToken`)
**Success:** 200

Cancel the caller's own pending sign-in email change; self-serve only

403 if the target id is not the caller's own member row. Always 200, even if there was nothing pending.

**Sign-in:** parent or adult token (`userToken`)
**Success:** 200

Set a kid member's 4-digit login PIN; admin or adult only

The target must have role child or teen (403 PIN_TARGET_INELIGIBLE otherwise). Setting a PIN also flips isChild on. Clears any existing lockout from prior wrong attempts.

**Sign-in:** parent or adult token (`userToken`)
**Success:** 200

Clear a kid member's login PIN; admin or adult only

Also flips isChild off and clears any existing lockout bucket.

**Sign-in:** parent or adult token (`userToken`)
**Success:** 200

Apply a pending email change from the emailed confirm link

PUBLIC: the recipient may not be signed in. The token is the credential (its SHA-256 hash is matched server-side); single-use and expires 24h after the admin started the change. Sends a best-effort completion notice to the OLD address on success (never blocks this response). The web ConfirmEmail screen requires an explicit click before calling this: it never auto-fires on page load, so an email link-scanner prefetch cannot burn the token.

**Sign-in:** none
**Success:** 200

Invite someone to the family; admin or adult only

role is one of admin | adult | teen | guest (default adult). Granting 'admin' requires the caller to already be an admin (403 otherwise): FHS-486 / ADR 0019.

**Sign-in:** parent or adult token (`userToken`)
**Success:** 201

Resend a still-pending invitation email; admin or adult only

Re-fires the Supabase invite email (e.g. a typo'd address, or the email got lost). 404 if the invitation is not in this tenant; 409 if it is no longer pending (already accepted/expired).

**Sign-in:** parent or adult token (`userToken`)
**Success:** 200

Claim invites addressed to the caller's own email

Called right after sign-in when the caller has no membership yet. For each matching pending invitation, links an unclaimed seat (or creates one, for a members-page invite with no pre-created seat) to the caller and flips the invitation to accepted. No tenant header required: the invitation rows carry the tenant scope.

**Sign-in:** parent or adult token (`userToken`)
**Success:** 200

Everything the Today/Dashboard tab renders, in one round-trip

Bundles the roster, per-kid habit progress, weekly streaks, pending-task counts, a Today's Snapshot stat row, savings goals, and a merged Recent Activity feed (tasks, meals, calendar activities, habit stickers and approved reward redemptions, newest 5) instead of fanning out to five separate endpoints.

**Sign-in:** parent or adult token (`userToken`)
**Success:** 200

List tasks

**Sign-in:** parent or adult token (`userToken`)
**Success:** 200

Create a task for myself; any member

Always owned by the caller: memberId comes from the session, never the body.

**Sign-in:** parent or adult token (`userToken`)
**Success:** 201

Replace one of my own tasks' title/dueDate; any member

Owner-scoped, same WHERE as PATCH/DELETE. memberId and completion state (doneAt) are not editable here.

**Sign-in:** parent or adult token (`userToken`)
**Success:** 200

Tick/untick one of my own tasks; any member

Owner-scoped: a member can only mutate their own tasks. 404 covers both wrong-owner and not-found, by design, so a probe can't enumerate another member's task ids.

**Sign-in:** parent or adult token (`userToken`)
**Success:** 200

Delete one of my own tasks; any member

**Sign-in:** parent or adult token (`userToken`)
**Success:** 204

List the family's assignments (homework/chores); any member

Ordered by due date ascending (undated last), then created_at: open/overdue assignments sit on top, undated ones trail behind.

**Sign-in:** parent or adult token (`userToken`)
**Success:** 200

Create an assignment; admin/adult only

**Sign-in:** parent or adult token (`userToken`)
**Success:** 201

Replace an assignment's title/notes/dueDate/assignee; admin/adult only

Completion state (done/doneAt) is owned by PATCH and left untouched here, so editing a done assignment keeps it done.

**Sign-in:** parent or adult token (`userToken`)
**Success:** 200

Toggle an assignment done/not-done; admin/adult only

`done: true` stamps doneAt to now; `false` clears it.

**Sign-in:** parent or adult token (`userToken`)
**Success:** 200
